Richter saturates above magnitude ~7 and was calibrated for local Californian quakes; moment magnitude (Mw) measures the total energy released and works for all sizes globally.

mcqs.q: Why do meanders migrate across a floodplain?
options: Meanders form because rivers flow around obstacles like rocks.
Faster water on the outside of the bend causes erosion (river cliff); slower water on the inside causes deposition (slip-off slope) — over time the channel shifts laterally.
